# Fixture attribution

- Source: Open Bandit Dataset sample, Men's campaign.
- Origin repo: https://github.com/st-tech/zr-obp @ commit `8cbd5fa4558b7ad2ba4781546d6604e4cc3e07c4`
- Files used: `obd/random/men/men.csv`, `obd/bts/men/men.csv` (10k rows each).
- Fixtures: 2,000 rows per policy, drawn with `random_state=0`, saved with `index=False`.
